clips.title: The story
paras: Reports from the Tower of Althalaxx lead south into Ashenvale, where the Cult of the Dark Strand also threatens the woods. Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post sends you to the ruins of Ordil'Aran to recover a Glowing Soul Gem.

After the trouble around the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore, reports lead south to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post. The Cult of the Dark Strand is pressing into the ancient elven woods, and Delgren has fought them for a long time. Their reach crosses both territories, so he seeks to strike at the source of their sorcery.

The ruins of Ordil'Aran lie northeast of Maestra's Post, overrun by Dark Strand cultists. Delgren says their operatives carry glowing soul gems, vessels enchanted with magic that sustains the cult's power. Hunt the cultists among the ruins and recover one of the gems so Delgren can break its enchantment and uncover the source of their rite.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Balthule's letter is dire. This Cult of the Dark Strand is a thorn in my side that must be removed. I have been dealing with some of the Dark Strand scum northeast of here at Ordil'Aran. One of their number possesses a soul gem that I believe holds the secret to the cult's power.
Bring it to me, and I will be able to decipher the secrets held within.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you acquired that soul gem?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm, some dark magic enchants this soulstone. Let's see what's trapped inside, shall we?
